sgd.optimizer: ordinary SGD, no momentum, no clipping

inference: Pointwise 95% Student t intervals across independent seeds; paired bootstrap percentile CI for log-interpolated crossing ratio, 10000 resamples. No theorem-exponent claim from finite-depth measurements.
scope: Synthetic fresh Gaussian inputs only. No natural-language dataset copied to local desktop. All test predictions and synthetic inputs retained on server; only metrics, figures, source, compact parameters and manifests may be collected.
missing_identification: Terminal first-position derivative and zero-init SGD gradients are exactly zero. No arbitrary polar completion is called an estimate; zero-model prediction uses public candidate mean with deterministic positive tie. Frame/projector metrics are null where unidentified.
label_accounting: Same-beta n final labels. First-position selection n final labels plus 4096 unlabeled selection examples. Terminal selection n/2 subspace labels plus independent n/2 orientation labels plus 4096 unlabeled selection examples. SGD n fresh final labels. Test examples excluded from training counts and reported separately.
